First trip to Japan in spring

lena_r

We have traveled a lot in Europe but never in Asia, and we are planning two weeks in Japan next April. We are keen walkers in our sixties and would rather not join a bus tour. Is it realistic to plan the whole trip ourselves, and how many cities can we visit without spending every other day on a train?

3 replies

kenji

Planning it yourselves is very doable. Trains are punctual, signs are in English, and a two week rail pass covers Tokyo, Kyoto and Hiroshima with room to spare.

marta

Stay in three bases at most. We moved every second night on our first visit and regretted it, and Kyoto alone deserves five days.

odile

Since you like walking, look at the Nakasendo trail between Magome and Tsumago. A luggage forwarding service will carry your bags to the next inn.
